title: Unit Event — And Now, I Wear This Ribbon — Episode4 The Art That Tied Us Together

meta.Event: And Now, I Wear This Ribbon
meta.Episode: Episode4 — The Art That Tied Us Together
meta.Event Outline: Noticing how Mafuyu feels more at home surrounded by N25 puts a smile on Mizuki's face. Realizing how they're both alike in that sense, Mizuki recalls their former self before joining N25.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (K...? Is that a person's name or the name of a group...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(That didn't work...
Just “K” is way too short. I'm not getting any good search results.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Some people left comments, but they're all just saying, “K's so amazing,” and, “What do you think K's like?”)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Also, I decided to listen to their music on a whim. It's not like I really want to find out who...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Hang on... This illustration on PicShare... Is it fan art?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(“Based on music by K”...
Yeah, it has to be.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (A girl's crying as she sits beneath the moonlit sky. Based on her expression, she must've gotten lost in this forest and doesn't know where to go...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (This illustration... It goes so well with that first song I heard.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (They should have this as the thumbnail for that song instead of just a black rectangle.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And if it were up to me, I'd use it to make a video that...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (A video that begins with the moon from this illustration coming into focus... And it'd have this sort of retro color scheme to it...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It wouldn't be easy, but if I were to break it into parts, I might be able to animate it... Also...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I could throw in a few other effects...
Just a few...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: This is so awesome, if I do say so myself...! And I stayed faithful to the song's theme from start to finish...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I totally captured that strange mix of pain and kindness! Plus...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, no...!
I shouldn't be using someone else's art without asking them first!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Using art without asking first... I get that some people get carried away and do it without thinking, but I still hate when people do that...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I can enjoy it for myself since I haven't uploaded it...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But since I went through the trouble of actually making it, I kinda want to...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I could just send the artist a message with the expectation in mind that they'll turn me down...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Enanan...
That's pretty cute... I never would've guessed based on their art.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(How should I start my DM?
I guess I should introduce myself, so...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And that was the first music video I'd ever made...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So you discovered the music Kanade and Mafuyu had made, as well as Ena's art, during a time when you didn't want to go to school?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Why didn't you want to go to school, Mizuki...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Why...? Well, a lot of reasons...
Most of all, it just felt like such a drag...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And what happened after you sent Ena that message...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Fancy seeing you here at this time.
What's up?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I got up at a normal time and felt pretty refreshed, so I decided to work on my illustration.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I think I went a bit overboard. After a while, my body started feeling really tense, so I came over to take a quick break.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I see.
Hehe. As for us, you arrived right on cue.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Right on cue? Were you talking about me just now?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup. Well, to be fair, it wasn't about you specifically, but the time when we decided to join N25.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We were just at the part when I made a music video using your art without asking for your permission.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, I remember...!
I was totally floored by that message you sent me.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, imagine being asked, “I apologize if this is sudden, but I made a music video using your art. I'd like to ask you for permission to upload it online,” completely out of the blue.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And how did you feel after receiving that message, Ena...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Me?
Surprised, to say the least...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Back then, art was sort of ruling my life.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Ruling your life...?
Were you also going through a tough period?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, kinda...
You could say that I was at my wit's end...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'd like to hear more about what things were like back then for you, Ena. Along with how you discovered Kanade's music.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I don't know much about what happened before we started working together either...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Ena, you don't have to tell us if you don't want to...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I-It's not that don't want to...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, who am I kidding...?
What's the point of trying to hide anything at this point?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yes, I'm sure. It's not exactly a happy story, so try not to be disappointed, okay?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm... Where should I start...? Maybe just before the time I entered high school...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
High school...?
Don't you and Mizuki attend the same one?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, but I take classes at night.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And a lot happened before I ended up enrolling there. Simply put...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I couldn't get into the art school that I desperately wanted to go to...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(My hand won't stop shaking...
And it feels like everyone else here is a better artist than me...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Alright, just calm down...
I've been drawing literally forever...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Ever since I was really little...
Plus, until just recently, I attended that art class for sooo long...)

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: You don't have the talent to become an artist.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: I have nothing to say to you, Shinonome...

rows.Speaker: Exam Proctor
rows.Line: It's time to start the exam.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Crap, I lost my concentration...!
Where's the exam prompt...? Here it is... We're supposed to...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Sketch a glass vase using pencils...! Nice...! That's right up my alley!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Just watch! I'm gonna draw the perfect sketch...!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(It's so unbalanced...
Once more time... I have to redraw it...!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (You've gotta be kidding me... Why am I having so much trouble with this? I had never had any issues when I was still going to that art class...)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: I have nothing to say to you, Shinonome...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(No, I still can't get it right...
What do I do...?!)

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: You don't have the talent to become an artist.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I was being delusional... I thought I was a good artist, but in reality...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(No, no, no...!
How's there so little time left?! I haven't made any progress at all! This isn't right!!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I... I just have to clean it up and finish it...! B-But at this rate, I'm probably gonna...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (No! I absolutely don't want that to happen! If I fail... If I don't get accepted...)

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: You don't have the talent to become an artist.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Shut up...!
Shut up! Shut up!! Shut up!!

rows.Speaker: Mother's Voice
rows.Line:
Thank goodness you're not hurt...
But try not to push yourself too hard. I mean, I know art was...

rows.Speaker: Mother's Voice
rows.Line:
Okay...
Also, I bought some cake, so why don't you have some once you've settled down?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (What kind of daughter am I...? Taking my anger out on my own mother like that...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Why did things have to turn out this way...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I just wanted to draw...
I just wanted to become an artist...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (If I still want to... I have to keep drawing...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Just wait... I'm gonna keep drawing and prove you wrong...
